submit_request.description: One ordinary producer Event, or one atomic MLS Commit plus all recipient Welcome deliveries required by that Commit.

stream_scan_request.description: Positional single-stream scan request. Pagination is by stream_position, not by an opaque cursor: within one stream the governance Station's stream_position is a strict +1 total order, so the position IS the continuation token. Exactly one of after_position / before_position MUST be present; null means 'from the stream start' (after_position) or 'from the stream head' (before_position). Continuation is the caller's job: take the largest stream_position of this batch for after_position, the smallest for before_position.

after_position.description: Scan toward newer commits: return commits whose stream_position is strictly greater than this value, ascending. null starts at the stream start (position 0 included).

before_position.description: Scan toward older commits (history backfill): return commits whose stream_position is strictly smaller than this value, descending. null starts at the current stream head. This is the successor of the withdrawn timeline.prev_cursor backfill surface.

event.description: Committed event as delivered to this caller. A full EventEnvelope is the only reducer input shape; when the target Realm policy denies reference disclosure to this caller the row carries RedactedEventView or ReferenceLockedEventStub instead (zh/models/relation.md §4.5 Raw Event API boundary), which are projection-only evidence and MUST NOT be fed to a reducer.

stream_scan_outcome.description: Positional scan result. There is no cursor and no has_more here: the caller continues from the largest (after_position) or smallest (before_position) stream_position of commits[].

commits.description: Contiguous commits of the requested stream, ordered by stream_position: ascending for after_position, descending for before_position. Callers MUST verify strictly consecutive positions and previous_commit_ref linkage within and across pages.

truncated.description: True when more commits exist beyond this page in the requested direction, i.e. the scan stopped on limit rather than on the end of the stream (stream start for before_position, current head for after_position).

committed_event_ref.description: Closed exact reference to one authority-committed Event. All four coordinates are verified against the returned RealmCommit; none is a hint.

source_ref_access.description: Source-signed, Directory-bound authorization. The authenticated caller service MUST equal directory_id; realm_id MUST match this request; every requested ref MUST be a byte-identical member of source_refs.

refs.description: Canonical ascending unique refs. Every stream_ref realm_id equals the request realm_id and every ref is a byte-identical member of source_ref_access.source_refs.

items.description: Only exact matches, in request order. Callers fail closed when any requested ref is absent.

final_stream_heads.description: Private state-transfer manifest whose canonical digest equals handoff.final_stream_heads_digest. It is not included in the public authority bundle.
